_about: Batch B4a (Platforms): concepts/plugin-map, concepts/platform-plugins, concepts/platform-interface, code/platforms-init, code/platforms-interface. Owner: the B4a writer.

platform-detector.short: A function with no arguments that returns the class name of a Platform subclass when its hardware is present, else None. vLLM has five built-in detectors.
platform-detector.long: Built-in detectors: tpu, cuda, rocm, xpu, cpu ({{cite vllm/platforms/__init__.py:231-237}}). An out-of-tree platform plugin is also a detector ({{cite vllm/platforms/__init__.py:254-259}}).

unspecified-platform.short: The fallback platform when no detector finds hardware. It has an empty device_type, so most device calls fail or return nothing.
unspecified-platform.long: Defined at {{cite vllm/platforms/interface.py:1493-1495}}; chosen at {{cite vllm/platforms/__init__.py:290-292}}.

platform-hook.short: A method of the Platform class that vLLM calls at a fixed point of the start-up or of a request, for example check_and_update_config or get_attn_backend_cls.

component-picker.short: A Platform method that returns the dotted class name of a part to use on this hardware, for example get_attn_backend_cls or get_device_communicator_cls.

dispatch-key.short: The PyTorch dispatcher key of a device, for example CUDA or PrivateUse1. Platform.dispatch_key holds it; the default is CPU.
dispatch-key.long: Default at {{cite vllm/platforms/interface.py:142-145}}; CUDA sets "CUDA" ({{cite vllm/platforms/cuda.py:230}}).
